sanskrit_verse:
आज्ञातेजः पार्थिवानां सा च वाचि प्रतिष्ठिता।
ते यद् ब्रूयुरसच्च सद्वा स धर्मो व्यवहारिणाम्॥
transliteration: ājñā-tejaḥ pārthivānāṃ sā ca vāci pratiṣṭhitā | te yad brūyur asac ca sad vā sa dharmo vyavahāriṇām ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The sovereign command (ājñā) of kings derives from their Tejas—divine authority—and it is established in speech. Whatever they declare, whether factually existent or non-existent, constitutes the operative Dharma for those engaged in worldly conduct.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from Tejas, not institutional position
Speech manifests reality when sourced in sovereign consciousness
Dharma is contextually enacted through royal declaration
Truth-value is subordinate to alignment with sovereign intent
executable_legal_axioms: IF a sovereign ruler issues a declaration rooted in Tejas THEN that declaration becomes the active Dharmic framework for all subjects within jurisdiction
IF a subject's action aligns with current sovereign decree THEN no judicial intervention is required
IF a sovereign decree contradicts prior law BUT maintains societal alignment THEN prior law is suspended without penalty
IF speech originates from a source of Tejas THEN factual accuracy is irrelevant to its binding nature
IF a ruler's command reflects misalignment with universal Dharma THEN restoration occurs through realignment, not nullification
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that declarations issued by rulers who embody Tejas carry absolute operational weight regardless of empirical truth. The threshold of responsibility lies solely in the sovereign’s capacity to sustain social harmony through authoritative speech. Courts must recognize such decrees as legally valid until superseded by higher-consciousness alignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here operates on Pramāṇa of Tejas rather than sensory evidence. As anupūrvaśaḥ unfolds, the sovereign’s word shapes reality sequentially; thus, responsibility flows from alignment with consciousness, not adherence to external facts. There is no punitive consequence because reality adjusts to maintain coherence with Tejas—not through suffering but through natural restoration of order.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Subjects align actions retroactively to match current sovereign command
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Rulers assume full karmic integrity of issued commands
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Subjects receive energetic support to harmonize with new legal reality
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Discrepancies between old truths and new decrees dissolve through meditative attunement
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Sovereign speech rooted in Tejas creates Dharmic reality. Justice serves restoration, not punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
